name: Simple Guns [FFA]
desc:
Cartoon  Shooter! 

Dive into a chaotic cartoon world where you're dropped into the arena with a random weapon! 🔫 Your mission? Frag other players to earn sweet cash 💰 and valuable XP! Spend your hard-earned dough on awesome gear ⚙️ and climb the ranks with every kill! 🏆

Made entirely solo! 👨‍💻 I believe this is the only game where you can blast your opponents with a Labubu toy! 😂
